label: Publisher traffic with planted bots
note: Four bot groups are hidden in this export (headless Chrome, scripts on cloud hosts, a crawler and a proxy). A correct result is about 12% bots and 5% suspect, with those groups listed.

label: Clinic booking log, French headers
note: French column names, hh:mm:ss durations and OUI/NON bookings. Check every column choice by hand; about 16 to 17% of sessions are automated, and the booking rate should be worked out on humans only.

label: Giving day with real donors on corporate networks
note: Real donors come through employer networks and privacy relays that look like bots. Only about 4% of sessions are real bots, so do not exclude those networks.

label: Awareness channels that rarely convert
note: Podcast, LinkedIn and review-site traffic with almost no last-click sales. Set the extra segment column to "source". All of it is human, so nothing should be excluded.
